propositions: subprocess.run with capture_output=True and check=True discards git's stderr, making git fetch failures undiagnosable and reporting only exit status 128.
dc_store_copy_repo fixture fails hard on transient git fetch network errors with no retry mechanism on the critical path of a 41-minute live job.

The fetch, archive and ls-tree calls in dc_store_copy_repo must route through a helper that captures output, performs its own exit check, and raises RuntimeError with the command, exit status and git's stderr verbatim.

fetch_tickets must retry a failing fetch a bounded number of times with backoff before failing, with policy set to retry-then-FAIL rather than retry-then-skip to preserve coverage on genuine misconfiguration.

Unit tests must verify the error message carries git's stderr plus remote/branch/status, retry succeeds after transient failure, and attempt count is capped while preserving the diagnostic on final failure.
